title: Clearpath partner invitation
invited: You have been invited to be a Clearpath {role} partner
email: Open this link to review and accept the invitation.
unavailable: This invitation is no longer available.

settings.recommendation: A backup partner is strongly recommended.
settings.failure: Could not update invitations. Check that the pairing service is running, then refresh.
settings.invalidEmail: Enter a synthetic address ending in @example.test.
settings.conflict: Invitation status changed. Refresh before making another change.
settings.changeRule: Changing an accepted partner needs approval from the other partner or the one being replaced, or 7 days with no answer. The replaced partner is told.
settings.soloWarning: Without a partner, nobody is told when you remove a block or undo Clearpath. You can undo Clearpath without anyone knowing.
settings.soloAcknowledge: I understand I can undo Clearpath without anyone knowing
settings.complete: Setup complete. Removing a block or changing an accepted partner now needs partner approval or a 7-day wait.

missedCheckIn.subject: Clearpath hasn't checked in
missedCheckIn.body: This Mac hasn't checked in for 24 hours. The Mac may simply be off. Please check in with the person you support.

change.subject: Clearpath partner change request
change.request:
Clearpath received a request to replace the {role} partner {current} with {email}.
Open the link to confirm your decision within seven days. If nobody responds, Clearpath will apply the change.
change.replaced: You are no longer the Clearpath {role} partner. {email} has been invited in your place.
change.timedOut: Seven days passed without a decision, so Clearpath replaced the {role} partner with {email}.
